title: How Commvault Governs Sensitive Data for AI Security | Commvault
summary: Commvault Data & AI Security helps discover, classify, and govern sensitive data – reducing exposure risk and supporting responsible AI use.
body_markdown:
What is sensitive data discovery, and why does it matter?


Sensitive data discovery automatically scans data environments to identify what exists, where it lives, and whether it contains regulated or confidential data. Without it, PII, PHI, and intellectual property can remain exposed – risk that grows with AI adoption. Commvault Cloud Risk Analysis helps teams gain visibility across structured and unstructured data in live and backup environments.


How does data classification reduce compliance risk?


Data classification organizes data by type and sensitivity – such as PII, PCI, or PHI – so controls can be applied where they matter most. Commvault Cloud Classification uses ML-based classifiers with prebuilt templates and custom schemas. Classified data can then be governed with access policies, masking, and reporting to support requirements like GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.


How does Commvault govern AI data access?


Commvault Cloud Data & AI Access Governance extends classification-based controls to AI systems and pipelines. Through Satori integration, it applies agentless controls to platforms like Snowflake and Databricks, with prompt monitoring to help reduce sensitive data exposure. Teams can restrict what data AI models access, what enters prompts, and what is returned in outputs.


What sensitive data does Commvault cover?


Commvault Data & AI Security supports discovery, classification, and access governance across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data in cloud and on-premises environments. Prebuilt classifiers cover PII, PHI, PCI, financial data, API keys, and intellectual property. Custom classifiers align with your data taxonomy, with agentless governance via Satori for structured platforms.


How does governance support responsible AI?


Commvault Cloud Data Rooms helps AI and data teams activate data responsibly by providing a governed workspace to discover, classify, and export trusted backup data in open AI-ready formats – with redaction and audit trails to help prevent sensitive data from entering training pipelines or model outputs.


How does Commvault support compliance?


Commvault provides discovery, classification, and access governance to support GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, CCPA, DORA, NIS2, and the EU AI Act. For data residency needs, Commvault Geo Shield helps maintain in-region control. Commvault Cloud Risk Analysis forms the foundation of this compliance posture – providing the discovery and audit evidence that regulators require.
